name: Winter's Heavy Heart
assumptions:
Passive "Secrets of Frost" is not modelled yet: the weapon contributes only its base ATK and secondary stat. R1 text: The equipping character gains "Silver-Tinged Blood Pact": The equipping character's Elemental Mastery is increased by 24 for every Cryo character present in the party. For every Electro character present in the party, the equipping character's ATK is increased by 4.8%. Up to 4 Cryo or Electro characters can provide the above buffs.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The effect of Silver-Tinged Blood Pact is changed to: For every Cryo or Electro character present in the party, the equipping character gains a 20-point Elemental Mastery boost and deals 6% increased Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
Obtain method is a guess from rarity and has not been verified in a source page.
Base ATK and secondary stat are from genshin-db only (not cross-checked in a second source).
